text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Prespecified order · 15 controllers on the same 128 synthetic patients · no ranking or clinical claim
95% intervals: Wilson for rates; patient bootstrap for return, conditional on fixed policies. Training-run and model uncertainty are excluded.
Every controller shares the same patient cohort; policy-patient rollouts are not independent patient replicates. Zero observed harm does not establish safety.
